_comment: Partner employers: companies that gave UAply their openings AND agreed to receive applications by email. Copy this file to uaply-partners.json (git-ignored) and put real employers there. An employer with no recorded consent is ignored. An employer with no contact address is link-out only. Never add a company that has not agreed. The entries below are placeholders. Optional per job, for the filters: "type" can be job, parttime, internship or coop; "posted" is a date like 2026-10-12; "perks" lists any of health, dental, vision, k401, match, loan, stock, pto, maternity, paternity, tuition; "commission_only": true marks a commission-only role. Delivery channels (see EMPLOYERS.md): "contact" is a recruiting email (applications arrive as email with the resume attached); "webhook" is an HTTPS address that receives each application as signed JSON, with "webhook_secret" used to sign it. An employer may use either or both.

employers.name: Example Partner Co
employers.consent: Placeholder only: replace with how and when this employer agreed, for example 'signed partner agreement 2026-10-12'

jobs.blurb: A placeholder listing that shows the format. It is not a real opening.
